recognize_zh: 骨髓抹片中巨噬細胞內與背景中散布大量 2–4 微米的小卵圓形微生物，每顆有一個圓形核及旁邊棒狀的動基體（kinetoplast），即利什曼原蟲無鞭毛體（Leishman-Donovan bodies）。
features: Low power: cellular aspirate particle with mixed hematopoietic cells and clusters of small inclusions
Numerous small oval organisms (approximately 2–4 µm) clustered within and around macrophages
High power: each amastigote with a round nucleus and adjacent small rod-shaped kinetoplast
Large macrophage with cytoplasm packed with amastigotes; free (extracellular) organisms from ruptured cells
Panel D: few organisms in a sparsely cellular field adjacent to red cells; staining is pale in this panel
describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smears show cellular particles with mixed hematopoietic elements and numerous macrophages. Many small oval organisms, each with a round nucleus and a small rod-shaped kinetoplast, are present within macrophage cytoplasm and scattered extracellularly. Occasional organisms are also seen in less cellular areas. Findings are consistent with Leishmania amastigotes (Leishman-Donovan bodies) and support a diagnosis of visceral leishmaniasis; confirmation by PCR, culture or serology is recommended.

ddx.vs: Histoplasma yeasts are similar in size but have a clear halo and lack a kinetoplast, and are GMS/PAS positive.
Yeasts divide by a central transverse septum and lack a kinetoplast.
Tachyzoites are crescent-shaped without a kinetoplast.
Platelets are granular, irregular and lack the discrete nucleus-plus-kinetoplast structure.
